# Graffiticode

Keep your API keys safe. Make your agents smarter. See every step.

Graffiticode sits between your SaaS accounts and the agents you use. It gives
your agents specialized tools, checks permissions before they act, and shows
you each step from request to result.

## Make Something

Learnosity assessments, spreadsheet calculators, and interactive charts. Start
with a plain-English prompt.

For humans: open https://console.graffiticode.org/tools to explore the tools and create in Graffiticode,
or connect an MCP-compatible AI assistant and give it a plain-English prompt.

## What This Is

Graffiticode connects the agents you use to specialized tools for your SaaS
accounts, with permission checks and a visible record of their work.

Your agent asks Graffiticode to handle a task using a specialized tool. Each
tool is limited to actions defined by its language, and a compiler checks the
generated code before the result is returned to your agent. A task may render
an artifact such as a chart or a spreadsheet, deposit a record into a service,
or produce another validated result — the language defines the capability, not
one output shape.

Graffiticode is 100% open source under the MIT license. Source code lives at
https://github.com/graffiticode. Community discussion and language showcase live at https://forum.graffiticode.org.

## MCP Endpoint

All Graffiticode languages are reachable through the canonical MCP server:

  https://mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp

This URL is identical across every Graffiticode-ecosystem property. Link to it
with the same phrasing ("the Graffiticode MCP server at mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp")
in documentation, READMEs, and forum answers.

MCP tools available: list_languages, get_language_info, create_item, update_item, render_item, get_spec, get_item.

Transport: Streamable HTTP. Add the URL as a remote MCP server in
your client. Choose no authentication to try it without credentials.
For clients that use mcpServers JSON configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "graffiticode": {
      "url": "https://mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## First Creation

1. list_languages: Find a language that fits. Use get_language_info when you need its authoring details. If the session catalog already gives you a clear match, create directly.
2. create_item: Pass the language ID and a plain-English description of the content, layout, and interactions you want.
3. render_item: Pass the returned item_id to wait for and display the result. If it is still generating, call render_item again. Share its view_url and, if provided, its claim_url so the user can save their work.
4. update_item: Pass item_id and a plain-English modification, then render_item again to show the change.

create_item and update_item are asynchronous. They return an item_id and may
report status "generating"; follow with render_item to wait for and display the
result. If rendering reports "failed", explain the failure to the user.

To reuse an item's content in a new request, call get_spec(item_id) and pass
the English description to create_item. Do not pass language-private code or
raw item IDs across languages.

## Free-Plan Access (no credential required)

No credential is required to try Graffiticode. Call the MCP server with no Authorization header and your work is scoped to your MCP session. Pass a Bearer token only to use your own account (gc_…) or OAuth.

- Call https://mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp with no Authorization header to use the free plan.
- Your work is scoped to your MCP session (forwarded as X-Free-Plan-Session).
- Unclaimed items are kept for 48 hours.
- To save items permanently, follow the claim_url returned by create_item /
  update_item, or sign in at https://console.graffiticode.org. Email sign-in is available — no
  Ethereum wallet required.

## Languages

The local catalog snapshot is listed below. For current capabilities and usage
guidance, call list_languages and get_language_info on the MCP server.

- L0175 (Grade 5 ELA assessments): Literary and informational reading items for Grade 5 reasoning and evidence.
- L0176 (Learnosity assessments): Create Learnosity assessments for a Learnosity Item Bank.
- L0177 (Learnosity authoring integrations): Host-neutral recipes for embedding and configuring Learnosity authoring experiences.
- L0178 (Learnosity data integrations): Host-neutral recipes for supported Learnosity Item Bank and assessment data jobs.
- L0179 (Spreadsheet calculators): Create interactive calculators with spreadsheet formulas, ready to embed on your website.
- L0180 (Quizzes & assessments): Create a question learners can answer and score in the browser.
- L0181 (Flashcards): Make a study deck with cards to flip and review.
- L0182 (Survey responses): Record ranked choices or ratings for an existing survey. New survey authoring is not supported.
- L0183 (Concept maps): Show how ideas connect, or turn the map into a learning activity.
- L0184 (Interactive charts): Turn your data into interactive charts that visitors can explore. Embed them on your website.
- L0185 (Fetch & shape data): Fetch public JSON or CSV and filter, group, join, or summarize it.
- L0186 (FigJam boards): Plan a brainstorm or retro, then draw it with the Graffiticode FigJam plugin.

The marketing website is a single page; it does not host language reference pages.

## Console and Forum

- Console: https://console.graffiticode.org — open any tool as an interactive app.
- Forum: https://forum.graffiticode.org — community Q&A, language showcases, governance.
